| [github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101/client](iec101-client.md) | Package client is the controlling station of IEC 60870-5-101: it brings up the link, polls the controlled station (unbalanced transmission) or exchanges messages with it (balanced transmission), runs requests (interrogation, counter interrogation, read, commands, clock synchronization, test, reset process, delay acquisition) and delivers monitor-direction ASDUs to a handler. |

| [github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec103/client](iec103-client.md) | Package client is the controlling system of IEC 60870-5-103: the primary station of unbalanced transmission (clause 6.2.3) that polls one item of protection equipment, runs the application functions of clause 7.4 (station initialization, time synchronization, general interrogation, general commands, generic services, disturbance data transfer) and delivers every monitor-direction ASDU to a handler. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec103/server](iec103-server.md) | Package server is the protection equipment of IEC 60870-5-103: the secondary station of unbalanced transmission (clause 6.2.3). |
